subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the strange person on the cliff

736510102.text: It is finally complete! The next step: demonstration! I will prove to all of them that this is the greatest of alchemical potions!

736510103.text: What is this person giggling by a cliff and talking to herself for...?

736510104.text: #Geez, she gives Paimon the creeps. {NICKNAME}, let's keep our distance, shall we?

736510107.text: Hey, hey! You don't have to worry so much about random strangers, you know?

736510108.text: Huh? When did you get here?

736510109.text: Talking bad behind someone else's back is rude, you know!

736510110.text: I, Hajanad, am Spantamad's Star of Tomorrow! Just you wait! When I become a famous researcher, I shall dedicate a trash-talk paper specially for you...

736510111.text: Wow, she's a real meanie! And her name sounds so difficult to say!

736510112.text: Wait! Could this little fellow... be the "White High-Intelligence Floating Assistive Unit" from those rumors?

736510113.text: What kinds of rumors were those!? Paimon's never heard of that nickname!

736510114.text: #Anyway, a {M#blond-haired}{F#blonde-haired} outlander with a "White High-Intelligence Floating Assistive Unit"... Today is my lucky day.

736510115.text: Ahem! Listen, I can make fighters stronger, so let's make a deal, alright?
